## Change and reason

Explain what this changes and why it helps readers. For a new resource, describe its Lichess connection and your experience evaluating it.

## Relevant context

Mention costs, access restrictions, or maintenance concerns. Mark this as not applicable for routine fixes.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/philyawj/awesome-lichess/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] I checked affected links and descriptions for accuracy.
- [ ] New recommendations meet the inclusion criteria and do not duplicate existing entries, or this change adds no resources.
- [ ] I followed the entry format and alphabetical ordering where applicable.
